instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot, eye-level. Inside a boxing gym with a white brick wall and black floor mats, the male trainer in a gray t-shirt (R1) stands on the left in profile, facing right. He holds the hand of the woman in a blue hoodie (R2), who stands on the right wearing pink boxing gloves and gray shorts. The trainer (R1) is adjusting the pink boxing glove on the hand of the woman (R2), who looks down at her hand. The background is clean with gym mats. Bright overhead gym lighting casts soft shadows, creating a natural, neutral-toned atmosphere.
elements: R1 adjusts the pink boxing glove on R2's hand
R1 holds R2's hand while working on her glove
R2 is the trainee whose gloved hand is being adjusted by R1
R2 looks down at her hand during R1's glove adjustment
pink boxing gloves are the contact-relevant training object
